include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND mode_s_decode_sources
    preamble_correlation_impl.cc)

set(mode_s_decode_sources
    "${mode_s_decode_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT mode_s_decode_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT mode_s_decode_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-mode_s_decode SHARED ${mode_s_decode_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-mode_s_decode gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-mode_s_decode
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-mode_s_decode PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_mode_s_decode_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-mode_s_decode PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-mode_s_decode)
